scope: Synthetic parser-only controls. No product tests, packages, services, databases or Provider invoked. No result here is real acceptance.

controls.name: five full JSON reports preserve named skips/todos and distinguish files from nested suites
canonical command transformation markers never become leaf reports
truncated JSON cannot become a complete report
identical log repeats retain occurrences without double-counting one logical report
aggregate counts must equal actual assertionResults
running/queued leaves remain incomplete even with matching aggregate counts
missing one of five package reporters blocks complete inventory
distinct same-package reports cannot be selected or merged
